sloka: इति एवम् विलपन् राजा जन ओघेन अभिसम्वृतः ।अपस्नातैव अरिष्टम् प्रविवेश पुर उत्तमम् ॥२-४२-२२॥
transliteration: iti evam vilapan rājā jana oghena abhisamvṛtaḥ ।apasnātaiva ariṣṭam praviveśa pura uttamam ॥2-42-22॥

translations.english: Thus the king, who looked like one after the inauspicious (funeral) bath, surrounded by streams of people entered the most beautiful city (Ayodhya) which portended misfortune.
